assistant|lg_tv_deal: Best Buy offers a discount of up to $200 on LG's OLED C9 series TVs.

assistant|lg_tv_recommendation: For best picture quality choose the OLED C9 series; on a budget the NanoCell SM9X series is a great alternative.
assistant|lg_oled_c9_picture_quality: LG OLED C9 has infinite contrast ratio, perfect blacks, wide color gamut, and 4K UHD resolution.
assistant|lg_oled_c9_viewing_angles: LG OLED C9 offers wide viewing angles with no color shift when viewed from the side.
assistant|lg_oled_c9_hdr: LG OLED C9 supports HDR10, Dolby Vision, and HLG (Hybrid Log-Gamma) HDR formats.
assistant|lg_oled_c9_processor: LG OLED C9 is powered by LG's α (Alpha) 9 Gen 2 intelligent processor.
assistant|lg_oled_c9_gaming: LG OLED C9 offers 1ms response time, NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility, and AMD FreeSync support.
assistant|lg_oled_c9_ai_image_enhancemen: LG OLED C9's AI-powered image enhancement uses content analysis, object detection, noise reduction, and color enhancement via the α9 Gen 2 processor.
assistant|lg_oled_c9_audio: LG OLED C9 supports Dolby Atmos with height channels and DTS:X object-based audio.
LG OLED C9 has a 2.2 channel down-firing speaker system with 40W total power output.
LG OLED C9 supports Hi-Res audio formats FLAC, WAV, and ALAC, plus Bluetooth wireless audio streaming and Audio Return Channel (ARC).
